timeline: Anna arrives at the estate for a job interview.
Anna counts 47 steps from rental car to front door.
Anna meets Marcus, the husband, at the door.
Marcus explains his wife's condition and the previous housekeeper left suddenly.
Anna reads aloud a list of rules: no visitors, no east wing, no questions about locked room on second floor, etc.
Anna meets the wife in her sitting room; wife is composed but fragile, with trembling hands and sharp eyes.
Wife claims to have seen Anna's full name on the application form, but Anna only wrote 'Anna'.
Anna finds a note behind the dryer: 'HE KNOWS. GET OUT BEFORE THE 15TH.'
Anna questions the gardener about Clara; gardener is evasive and warns the house 'eats people'.
Anna examines the locked door in the east wing; the bolt is new and bolted from the outside (someone locked in, not out).
Anna calls Tommy, a contact she hasn't spoken to in six months.
Anna finds a woman's Patek Philippe watch with a cracked crystal in Marcus's unlocked desk drawer; the back is engraved 'E.M.'
Anna hides the watch in her apron pocket.
Anna overhears Marcus on the phone saying 'That woman' is not allowed back on the property; he sounds fearful and angry.
Marcus tells Anna to leave the study and not disturb his wife.
Anna finds a bloodstained uniform shirt with Clara's name tag hidden under a loose floorboard in Marcus's closet.
Anna confronts Marcus about his whereabouts at midnight; Marcus claims he took a walk, but Anna says she would have seen him.
Anna walks into Marcus's study with the shirt and watch and demands explanations, threatening to go to the police.
Marcus admits Clara died (did not leave), and claims his wife killed her and framed him.
Police interview Anna, Marcus, and the wife separately about Clara's death.
Anna lies to police about how she found the shirt and her criminal record.
The wife thanks Anna for not telling the police the truth.
The wife reveals she was sexually abused by her father starting at age seven.
Anna picks the lock on the east wing door and enters the locked room.
Anna finds a journal on the desk with her real name handwritten on the cover by the wife.
Anna reads the journal: the wife has been planning for six months to frame Marcus for Clara's murder and then frame Anna for Marcus's murder on the 15th.
Anna discovers photographs of herself (leaving prison, on bus, at employment agency), Marcus, and Clara (alive, smiling with the wife).
Anna learns from the journal that Clara was a mistake — the wife killed her, Marcus found the body, and has been blackmailing the wife ever since.
Anna discovers a hidden camera in a teddy bear on the bookshelf in the east wing study.
Anna watches footage of the wife (Lydia) planting the bloody shirt under the floorboard in Marcus's study three weeks before Anna arrived.
Anna realizes the wife had been preparing for a patsy (not specifically her) and that the locket given to her by the wife contains a hidden compartment.
Anna saves the memory card from the camera into the locket's hidden compartment.
Lydia confronts Marcus with a will, demanding he sign over everything (estate, accounts, company shares).
Lydia shows Marcus edited footage from a USB drive, claiming Anna planted the evidence against him.
Anna reveals she has the full footage on the memory card from the teddy bear camera, showing Lydia planting the shirt.
Lydia pulls a small silver gun and points it at Anna, demanding the memory card.
